retrieval.text: As an administrator, I want duplicate derived student numbers rejected so that PS and EVE do not create two records for the same student number. Acceptance criteria: - A second record with an existing derived student number is rejected. - The PS/EVE suffix does not make the derived student number unique. - The system reports a clear validation error.
